requiredContracts: Every QML app manifest resolves to an existing entry point
AppHost times out failed QML launches and returns through its opaque failure panel
Browser fullscreen support is configured through WebEngine settings
Settings Update & Recovery, Backup & Restore, Performance and Advanced surfaces are populated
Music and Gallery use canonical user media paths
Media Optimizer persists incremental scan batches
System capture saves screenshots and recordings into Gallery-indexed folders
App Store browse and updates surfaces exclude installed-app management
